newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Eastern to issue 167 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: China Eastern to issue 167 mln new shares.

text.p: China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd said it would issue an additional 166.95 million new H-shares at HK$1.39 per share to cover an over-allotment option exercised by Morgan Stanley Asia Ltd.

The airline said the price was equivalent to the Hong Kong issue price of HK$1.38 per H-share of its recent initial public offering after taking into account the relevant brokerage payable in Hong Kong.

China Eastern said Morgan Stanley, global coordinator of its offer, had on behalf of the U.S. underwriters exercised the over-allotment option. The new shares are expected to be issued and listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange on February 21.

On completion of the deal, the total number of H-shares in issue will be increased to 1.57 billion H-shares, or 34.31 percent of the share capital of the airline, up from 1.40 billion H-shares or 31.82 percent, the statement said.
The airline said net proceeds of about HK$219.81 million would be raised from the new issue of shares.
China Eastern was listed on February 5. Its shares were unchanged at HK$1.39 per share at midday on Thursday.
